notes_for_editor: Three short listings only: firelookout.com (observation tower, decade-only dates, '1 mile west of Victor', elevation), Forest Lookouts (private co-operator, 8N-21W-36), and the firelookout.org list (coordinates, Tower Gone). Both dates are decade-only, so both events carry a null year. The listed coordinates (46.41069, -114.16477) may sit a few miles west of Victor rather than one mile; this is an unchecked estimate from memory of the town's position, so an editor should verify on a map before relying on it. Two WebSearch queries found no other record. No staffing, fire or access facts exist in the sources read; access level is not given.
